const IMAGES={};
for(const [family,urls] of Object.entries(SPRITE_URLS)){
 IMAGES[family]=urls.map(uri=>{const image=new Image();image.src=uri;return image;});
}
const norm=name=>String(name||'').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g,'');
const clamp=(x,a=0,b=1)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,x));
const lerp=(a,b,t)=>a+(b-a)*t;
const ease=t=>t<.5?2*t*t:1-Math.pow(-2*t+2,2)/2;
const TAU=Math.PI*2;
const PAL={normal:['#ffeda8','#c7d9e2'],fire:['#ffac42','#fff1ab'],water:['#2ab5ff','#cbf6ff'],grass:['#67dd70','#d3ffa1'],electric:['#ffe462','#fff9c9'],ice:['#a9efff','#f7ffff'],ground:['#b78b56','#fff0c1'],rock:['#99816d','#ebddc3'],poison:['#b06ae3','#f3c8ff'],ghost:['#8c5ec8','#e7c2ff'],psychic:['#db79db','#ffdbf7'],dragon:['#9a71ef','#edc7ff'],dark:['#634998','#c3adff'],fighting:['#d78563','#ffedd4'],flying:['#a4d5eb','#f7fcff'],steel:['#9fb6c5','#f4ffff'],bug:['#a6d56a','#f2ffb4'],fairy:['#e89ed0','#fff1fa']};
const PREV=window.PokemonTorreV360Paint;
const STATS={casts:0,frames:0,animatedSprites:0,canvasMoves:0,statusPaints:0,lockedPassThrough:0,latest4PassThrough:0,trackedMoves:{},failedSprites:0};
const CURRENT_FOUR=new Set(['mordida','labaredafinal','tsunami','soprododragao']);
const colors=(type)=>PAL[type]||PAL.normal;
function line(ctx,pts,col,width,alpha=1,glow=0){
 if(!pts.length)return;
 ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;ctx.lineJoin='round';ctx.lineCap='round';ctx.strokeStyle=col;ctx.lineWidth=width;
 if(glow){ctx.shadowBlur=glow;ctx.shadowColor=col;}
 ctx.beginPath();pts.forEach((p,i)=>i?ctx.lineTo(p[0],p[1]):ctx.moveTo(p[0],p[1]));ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();
}
function disc(ctx,x,y,r,col,alpha=1,glow=0){
 ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;ctx.fillStyle=col;
 if(glow){ctx.shadowBlur=glow;ctx.shadowColor=col;}
 ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,Math.max(.3,r),0,TAU);ctx.fill();ctx.restore();
}
function ring(ctx,x,y,r,col,alpha=.5,width=2){
 ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;ctx.strokeStyle=col;ctx.lineWidth=width;ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y,r,r*.70,0,0,TAU);ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();
}
function polygon(ctx,x,y,r,ang,n,color,alpha=.85){
 ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);ctx.rotate(ang);ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;ctx.fillStyle=color;
 ctx.beginPath();for(let i=0;i<n;i++){let a=i*TAU/n,rr=r*(i%2?.72:1);i===0?ctx.moveTo(Math.cos(a)*rr,Math.sin(a)*rr):ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(a)*rr,Math.sin(a)*rr);}ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();ctx.restore();
}
function leaf(ctx,x,y,rad,ang,col,alpha){
 ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);ctx.rotate(ang);ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;ctx.fillStyle=col;ctx.strokeStyle='#246642';ctx.lineWidth=.8;
 ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-rad,0);ctx.bezierCurveTo(-rad*.3,-rad,rad*.45,-rad,rad,0);ctx.bezierCurveTo(rad*.4,rad,-rad*.4,rad,-rad,0);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();
}
function spark(ctx,x,y,r,col,t,alpha=1){
 for(let i=0;i<4;i++){const a=i*Math.PI/2+t*3;line(ctx,[[x+Math.cos(a)*r*.3,y+Math.sin(a)*r*.3],[x+Math.cos(a)*r,y+Math.sin(a)*r]],col,1.8,alpha);}
}
function sprite(ctx,family,step,x,y,w,h,rotation,alpha){
 const arr=IMAGES[family];if(!arr?.length)return false;
 // Vários quadros alternados, movimento real (trajeto, rotação e tamanho). Não exibe imagem única estática.
 const item=arr[(Math.floor(step)%arr.length+arr.length)%arr.length];
 if(!item?.complete||!item.naturalWidth)return false;
 ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;ctx.translate(x,y);ctx.rotate(rotation);ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
 const aspect=item.naturalWidth/item.naturalHeight;
 const bw=Math.min(w,h*aspect*1.5),bh=Math.min(h,w/aspect*1.5);
 ctx.drawImage(item,-bw/2,-bh/2,bw,bh);ctx.restore();STATS.animatedSprites++;return true;
}
function familyFor(type){return ['fire','rock','poison','ghost','dark'].includes(type)?type:null;}
function moveProfile(fx){
 const name=norm(fx?.move?.name||fx?.name||''); const typ=fx?.move?.type||fx?.type||'normal';
 const kind=fx?.move?.kind||fx?.moveKind||fx?.kind||'bolt';
 const cfg=CONFIG[`${name}|${typ}|${kind}`]||CONFIG[`${name}|${typ}`];
 return {name,type:typ,kind,cfg,locked:LOCKED.has(name),latest:CURRENT_FOUR.has(name)};
}
function paint(ctx,fx,now,engine,profile){
 const start=fx.at||now,dur=Math.max(1,fx.duration||fx.end-start||680),t=clamp((now-start)/dur);
 const fade=clamp(Math.min(t*10,(1-t)*9,1));
 const [ax,ay]=fx.from||[0,0],[bx,by]=fx.to||[0,0];
 const vx=bx-ax,vy=by-ay,dist=Math.hypot(vx,vy)||1,nx=-vy/dist,ny=vx/dist;
 const [primary,bright]=colors(profile.type);
 const visual=profile.cfg?.visual||{};
 const scale=clamp(Number(visual.scale)||1,.55,1.7);
 const track=clamp(Number(visual.trail_factor)||1,.55,1.65);
 const frameMs=Math.max(45,Math.min(130,Number(visual.frame_ms)||75));
 const kind=profile.kind;
 const phase=ease(clamp((t-.03)/.76));
 const xx=lerp(ax,bx,phase),yy=lerp(ay,by,phase);
 const family=familyFor(profile.type);
 const seed=profile.name.length*11.5+(profile.name.charCodeAt(0)||0);
 const heavy=kind==='area'||kind==='quake'||kind==='hazard';
 const contact=['dash','contact','physical'].includes(kind);
 const burst=clamp((t-.52)/.48);
 const small=engine?.fps>0&&engine.fps<27;
 const parts=Math.max(4,Math.round((small?7:14)*track));
 if(['recover','shield','status','illusion','guard'].includes(kind)){
   const cx=ax,cy=ay,rad=14+t*33;
   for(let j=0;j<9;j++){
     const a=j*TAU/9+t*5+seed,px=cx+Math.cos(a)*rad,py=cy+Math.sin(a)*rad*.75;
     if(profile.type==='grass')leaf(ctx,px,py,4.4,a,primary,fade*.77);
     else if(profile.type==='electric')spark(ctx,px,py,4.5,bright,t,fade*.7);
     else polygon(ctx,px,py,3.5,a,5,j%2?primary:bright,fade*.82);
   }
   ring(ctx,cx,cy,13+t*29,primary,fade*.44,1.8);
   STATS.statusPaints++;return;
 }
 if(contact){
   // Ataque corpo a corpo: nada de feixe de longa distância; cortes aparecem no local do impacto.
   const q=clamp((t-.28)/.65);
   if(q>0){
     for(let j=0;j<3;j++){
       const angle=Math.atan2(vy,vx)+Math.PI/2+(j-1)*.4;
       const off=(j-1)*10;
       const cx=bx+nx*off,cy=by+ny*off;
       const pts=[];for(let i=0;i<=10;i++){const z=i/10;pts.push([cx+Math.cos(angle)*((z-.5)*31),cy+Math.sin(angle)*((z-.5)*31)+Math.sin(Math.PI*z+q*5)*5]);}
       line(ctx,pts,j%2?primary:bright,3-j*.55,fade*(.8-j*.12),4);
     }
     ring(ctx,bx,by,10+q*29,bright,fade*.55,2.3);
     for(let j=0;j<7;j++){
       const a=j*TAU/7+seed,rr=7+q*24;
       polygon(ctx,bx+Math.cos(a)*rr,by+Math.sin(a)*rr*.75,2+j%2,a,4,primary,fade*.7);
     }
   }return;
 }
 if(heavy){
   const R=(14+phase*34)*scale;
   for(let j=0;j<(small?12:21);j++){
     const a=j*2.399+seed*.08,rad=(j%4)*5+R*.42+burst*14;
     const cx=bx+Math.cos(a)*rad,cy=by+Math.sin(a)*rad*.63;
     if(family){if(!sprite(ctx,family,(now-start)/85+j*.7,cx,cy,17+j%3*3,17+j%3*3,t*5+a,fade*.76))polygon(ctx,cx,cy,5,a,5,primary,fade*.5);}
     else if(profile.type==='grass')leaf(ctx,cx,cy,5+j%3,a,primary,fade*.73);
     else if(profile.type==='water')ring(ctx,cx,cy,5+j%3,bright,fade*.55,2);
     else if(profile.type==='electric')spark(ctx,cx,cy,3.8,bright,t,fade*.82);
     else polygon(ctx,cx,cy,5,a,profile.type==='ice'?6:5,j%3?primary:bright,fade*.7);
   }
   for(let n=0;n<3;n++)ring(ctx,bx,by,R*(.57+n*.24),n%2?bright:primary,fade*(.35-n*.07),2);
   if(profile.type==='fire'&&t>.5)engine.shake=Math.max(engine.shake||0,1.2); // leve, não mexe em golpes protegidos.
   return;
 }
 // Projétil/raio/homing: sequência de quadros oriundos das sheets, partículas em deslocamento e impacto.
 const beam=['beam','pierce'].includes(kind);
 const trail=beam?Math.max(6,Math.round((small?12:22)*track)):parts;
 const pts=[];
 for(let j=0;j<=14;j++){
   const q=(j/14)*phase;
   pts.push([lerp(ax,bx,q)+nx*Math.sin(q*14+t*21+seed)*5,lerp(ay,by,q)+ny*Math.cos(q*14+t*18+seed)*4]);
 }
 if(beam){line(ctx,pts,primary,profile.type==='water'?9:6,fade*.40,7);line(ctx,pts,bright,2.2,fade*.83,4);}
 else if(profile.type==='water'||profile.type==='dragon'||profile.type==='electric')line(ctx,pts,primary,2.2,fade*.38,5);
 for(let j=0;j<trail;j++){
   const q=clamp((j/(trail-1))*phase);
   const wobble=Math.sin(j*1.29+now*.014+seed)*(5+7*q);
   const cx=lerp(ax,bx,q)+nx*wobble*.75,cy=lerp(ay,by,q)+ny*wobble*.5;
   const size=(4+(j%4)*1.25)*scale,alpha=fade*(.27+.65*q);
   if(family&&!(j%2)){
     if(!sprite(ctx,family,(now-start)/frameMs+j*.31,cx,cy,size*3.6,size*3.2,Math.atan2(vy,vx)*.25+t*2+j*.27,alpha)){
        STATS.failedSprites++;polygon(ctx,cx,cy,size,j+t*3,5,primary,alpha);
     }
   }else if(profile.type==='water'){
     disc(ctx,cx,cy,size*1.15,primary,alpha,5);disc(ctx,cx+1,cy-1,size*.58,bright,alpha*.85);
   }else if(profile.type==='grass'){
     leaf(ctx,cx,cy,size*1.3,Math.atan2(vy,vx)+Math.sin(t*12+j)*.6,primary,alpha);
   }else if(profile.type==='electric'){
     spark(ctx,cx,cy,size,bright,t+j,alpha);
   }else if(profile.type==='flying'){
     line(ctx,[[cx-size*1.4,cy+size*.6],[cx,cy-size],[cx+size*1.5,cy-size*.25]],bright,1.8,alpha);
   }else if(profile.type==='psychic'||profile.type==='fairy'){
     ring(ctx,cx,cy,size*1.1,j%2?bright:primary,alpha*.62,1.8);
   }else if(profile.type==='ice'){
     polygon(ctx,cx,cy,size*1.35,t*5+j,6,bright,alpha);
   }else if(profile.type==='steel'){
     polygon(ctx,cx,cy,size*1.3,t*5+j,4,j%2?primary:bright,alpha);
   }else if(profile.type==='bug'){
     line(ctx,[[cx-size,cy-size],[cx+size,cy+size]],primary,2.6,alpha);line(ctx,[[cx+size,cy-size],[cx-size,cy+size]],bright,1.4,alpha);
   }else{
     polygon(ctx,cx,cy,size,t*3+j*.4,5,j%3?primary:bright,alpha);
   }
 }
 if(t>.37){
   ring(ctx,bx,by,9+burst*24,bright,fade*.6,2);
   for(let j=0;j<8;j++){
     const a=j*TAU/8+seed,rad=9+burst*(12+j%3*4);
     if(profile.type==='grass')leaf(ctx,bx+Math.cos(a)*rad,by+Math.sin(a)*rad*.65,4,a,primary,fade*.63);
     else disc(ctx,bx+Math.cos(a)*rad,by+Math.sin(a)*rad*.7,2.7+j%2,j%2?primary:bright,fade*.65,3);
   }
 }
}
window.PokemonTorreV360Paint=function(ctx,fx,now,engine){
 const p=moveProfile(fx);
 if(p.locked){STATS.lockedPassThrough++;return PREV?PREV(ctx,fx,now,engine):false;}
 if(p.latest){STATS.latest4PassThrough++;return PREV?PREV(ctx,fx,now,engine):false;}
 if(!fx?.move?.name)return PREV?PREV(ctx,fx,now,engine):false;
 try{paint(ctx,fx,now,engine,p);STATS.frames++;STATS.canvasMoves++;STATS.trackedMoves[p.name]=(STATS.trackedMoves[p.name]||0)+1;return true;}
 catch(error){console.warn('[V35.68] Não foi possível animar '+p.name,error);return PREV?PREV(ctx,fx,now,engine):false;}
};
// Efeitos de condições/status não seguem a mesma fila de golpes de dano, portanto possuem uma fila independente.
const PREV_USE=BattleEngine.prototype.useMove;
BattleEngine.prototype.useMove=function(slot){
 const b=battle,m=b?.active?current():null,move=m?skillSet(m)?.[slot]:null;
 const name=norm(move?.name||'');
 if(!move||!b?.active||LOCKED.has(name)||CURRENT_FOUR.has(name))return PREV_USE.apply(this,arguments);
 const before=b.energy,cd=cooldowns[slot]||0,now=performance.now();
 const result=PREV_USE.apply(this,arguments);
 const accepted=(b.energy<before)||(cooldowns[slot]||0)>cd;
 if(accepted){STATS.casts++;if(move.kind==='status'||move.cat==='status'||['recover','shield','guard','illusion'].includes(move.kind)){
    this.v3568StatusFX||=[];this.v3568StatusFX.push({at:now,duration:720,from:[this.player.x,this.player.y-this.h*.12],to:[this.player.x,this.player.y-this.h*.12],move:{...move}});
    this.v3568StatusFX=this.v3568StatusFX.slice(-10);
 }}
 return result;
};
const PREV_DRAW=BattleEngine.prototype.draw;
BattleEngine.prototype.draw=function(now){
 const res=PREV_DRAW.call(this,now);
 if(!battle?.active||!this.ctx)return res;
 const effects=this.v3568StatusFX||[];
 if(effects.length){this.ctx.save();for(const fx of effects){if(now<=fx.at+fx.duration){try{paint(this.ctx,fx,now,this,moveProfile(fx));}catch(ex){console.warn('[V35.68] efeito de status',ex);}}}this.ctx.restore();this.v3568StatusFX=effects.filter(fx=>now<fx.at+fx.duration);}
 return res;
};
// Mantém os sprites aprovados intocados e atualiza apenas identificação da versão.
const oldRender=render,oldRenderBattle=renderBattle;
function showVersion(){
 const el=document.querySelector('.brand strong');if(el)el.textContent='POKÉMON TORRE · V35.69';
 const tag=document.getElementById('v30VersionTag');if(tag)tag.textContent='V35.69 · 3 GOLPES MELHORADOS';
 const home=document.getElementById('v3520VersionHome');if(home)home.textContent='V35.69';
 document.title='Pokémon Torre V35.69 · 3 Golpes Melhorados';
}
render=function(){const r=oldRender.apply(this,arguments);showVersion();return r;};
renderBattle=function(){const r=oldRenderBattle.apply(this,arguments);showVersion();return r;};
window.PokemonTorreV3568Diagnostics=()=>({version:'35.68',catalogMoves:Object.keys(CONFIG).length,protectedNames:[...LOCKED],...STATS,loadedSprites:Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(IMAGES).map(([k,v])=>[k,v.filter(img=>img.complete&&img.naturalWidth>0).length]))});
showVersion();
})();
